entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold for the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is Charlie. How can I help you today?
Hi Charlie... I hope you can help. I bought some cycling shoes a little while ago and they're just not working out. I feel awful about it.
I'm sorry to hear they aren't working for you. I can certainly look into this. To start, could you tell me your order number or the email address associated with your VeloFit account?
Yes, the email is sadcyclist88@email.com. I've been a loyal customer for years, I just... I really needed these to be perfect.

Okay, I have your account pulled up. I see the order for the Pro-Vibe Cycling Shoes, delivered 13 days ago. To make sure I understand, what specifically is the issue? Is it a technical fault or more of a preference issue with the fit?

It's the fit. I've tried everything, moving the cleats around, different socks... but I keep getting terrible blisters on my heels. I can't even ride for 10 miles. I was so excited, and now I'm just disappointed and out the money I really needed.
Getting blisters is definitely not the experience we want for our riders, and I completely understand your frustration. Let me just double-check our policy for you. One moment.

Okay, thank you for waiting. I've confirmed that our standard return policy for items like these cycling shoes is 90 days. Since you received them just 13 days ago, you are well within the window to send them back for a full refund.
Oh, really? So I can get a refund? That... that's such a relief. I was so worried I'd be stuck with them.

Absolutely. I've just initiated the return in our system. I'm sending a prepaid shipping label to the email on file right now. Just print it out, attach it to the original box, and drop it off at any post office. Once we receive it, the refund will be processed back to your original payment method within 3-5 business days.
Thank you, Charlie. You have no idea how much this helps. I really appreciate it.
You're very welcome. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
No, that was everything. Thanks again!
My pleasure. Have a great day and thank you for calling VeloFit.
